text: Salma and Bilal are celebrating ten years married on Saturday. Remind me to send flowers that morning.
Lunch with Teresa. She's gone fully vegan since September and says oat milk is the only one she can stand in coffee.
Finn proposed to Ellie on the beach in Cornwall last weekend! The ring belonged to his grandmother.
Need to order the cake for Mum and Dad's anniversary dinner on the 14th at 7pm. Dad is diabetic, so nothing too sweet.
Bao is allergic to sesame, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering before the dinner party.
Kiara's wedding is the 3rd of May. She asked me to do a reading and I said yes.
Cem mentioned his parents' 40th anniversary is coming up in November. His sister Yara is organising a surprise lunch and he's dreading the speech.
Picked up dry cleaning and returned the parcel. Still need stamps.
Shira only drinks peppermint tea after 4pm. Doesn't do caffeine late.
Remind me to text Darius good luck the night before his best man speech. The wedding is Saturday at 2pm and he's terrified.
Dawit and his wife are off to Lisbon for their anniversary next Thursday. Back on Monday.

Call from Julia. Her brother Colm got engaged to his girlfriend of six years, finally. The family are thrilled. She thinks the wedding will be in Galway next summer, and their mum is already planning outfits. Colm's fiancée is vegetarian and apparently the whole O'Brien side is horrified about the menu.
Vera's coeliac, so the restaurant needs to be one that does proper gluten-free, not just salads.
Don't forget to ask Santiago how the tasting at the venue went. It was yesterday afternoon.
Archie is going teetotal for October and is weirdly evangelical about alcohol-free IPA.

Layla's sister Nina is getting married in Marrakech in April. Layla is a bridesmaid and has to fly out three days before for the henna night. She's nervous about the flight because she hates flying, and her husband can't get the time off work. I should send her something nice for the trip, maybe a travel pillow.
Lukas said Marta loves really dark chocolate, the 85% stuff. Could be good for her birthday.
Wedding's off. Jack and Zainab split up last month and he's not doing well. I should check in with him this weekend.
Booked the table for Friday at 8.
Siddharth doesn't eat beef, and his wife Mabel is vegetarian. Their two kids will eat anything as long as it's pasta.

Coffee with Krisztina this morning. She and Karan are getting married on the 12th at half 9 at the registry office, just the two of them and their parents. Then a big party the next day at his uncle's farm. I need to RSVP by Friday and should ask whether there's a dress code. Also she mentioned Karan is lactose intolerant, so no cheese board as a gift.
Anan has stopped drinking entirely. Health reasons, he said, didn't go into it.
Salma's dog Pickle had his operation this morning. Remind me to message her this evening to see how he is.
Teresa and Callum's engagement party is Saturday from 7. I'm bringing the prosecco.

Ellie is nervous about the wedding planning, mainly because her mum keeps changing the guest list. Need to take her out for a drink next week. She's off alcohol at the moment, so somewhere with decent mocktails. Finn is no help apparently, he just says yes to everything.
Bilal can't stand coriander. Says it tastes like soap.
Yara's first anniversary with Finn is on Sunday. Remind me the day before to drop off the card.
Mrs Okafor next door told me her daughter is pregnant and due in March. She's knitting already.
Colm O'Brien, Colly to everyone at work, is moving to Dublin after the wedding. Leaving do is the 30th.
Kiara wants to try that new Ethiopian place. Dawit recommended it, says the injera is brilliant.

Chat with Shira after book club. Her parents renewed their vows last month in Haifa, and she said it was the most emotional day she's had in years. She loves anything with pistachio, which is handy because her birthday is coming up.
Must buy a present for Zainab's wedding. The list is online and the wedding is two weeks on Saturday.
Santiago Bianchi is doing a sober October fundraiser. Sponsor him before the end of the month.
Gym, then groceries, then meal prep for the week.
Vera and Lukas are celebrating their engagement with dinner at ours on Friday at 7.30. Vera's gluten-free and Lukas hates mushrooms, so I'm doing the lamb.
Darius said the speech went down a storm. Ask him for the video.
Callum's grandparents have their 60th wedding anniversary on Boxing Day. He's planning a family photo shoot that morning.
Archie's cat Biscuit went missing on Tuesday and turned up yesterday evening, very pleased with himself.
Remind me to ring Teresa the week after the wedding to see how the honeymoon went.

Marta is training for her first marathon and has cut out sugar entirely until the race in April. She's grumpy about it. Lukas says she's been sneaking jelly babies on long runs, which apparently doesn't count. The race is on the 26th at 9am, and I want to be at the finish line. Remind me to make her a sign the day before.
Need to book a taxi for Sunday at 6am. Flight's at 9.
Bao and his partner Kiara have been together eight years and are thinking about eloping. He asked me not to say anything yet.
Nina says her husband only drinks Guinness, never lager. Remember for the barbecue.

Spoke to Cem tonight. His wedding is in three weeks and the caterer has just cancelled, so he's scrambling. His fiancée Julia wants a Turkish menu to honour his family, but her dad is allergic to nuts, which rules out half of it. I said I'd ask my cousin, who runs a catering company. Should call her tomorrow morning before work.
Mabel's 50th wedding anniversary party was lovely. Must write her a thank-you note this week.

Karan got the promotion! Celebration drinks Thursday after work. He starts as team lead on the 1st. His wife Krisztina is chuffed but says he'll be unbearable now. He only drinks gin and tonic, Hendrick's with cucumber, so I could grab a bottle as a congrats.

Jack's mum has her knee replacement on Monday at 10. He's taking the week off to look after her. She's stubborn and won't let anyone help, so he's worried. I should drop round some food that evening, something soft, she's gone off spicy things since the last operation.
Krisztina only drinks white wine, ideally something dry like a Picpoul.
Ellie and Finn's engagement shoot is on the 2nd. She wants a vintage dress and is hunting charity shops.
Remind me to send Siddharth congratulations the day after his wedding, not before. He's superstitious.
Layla says she's been struggling since the move. Her husband is working nights and she barely sees him.
Our anniversary is on the 22nd. Booked the cottage in the Lakes for that weekend.
Dinner at Zainab's. Her fiance Anan cooked an incredible biryani. He's a chef at a hotel in Leeds, and he's lactose intolerant, which amazes me given how much ghee was involved.
Dr Adeyemi retires at Christmas. Collection is going round, card on Friday.
Sam and his husband are celebrating their fifth anniversary in Rome next month. Sam wants to propose a second time with a new ring and has asked me to help pick one on Saturday afternoon.
Uncle Darius is a whisky man. Single malt, nothing peaty. Good to know for Christmas.

Bilal said the hen do was a disaster. Salma's maid of honour forgot to book the restaurant, so they ended up at a Wetherspoons. Salma laughed it off but Bilal said she was upset that night. I should ask her about it gently next time we're out.
Yara has the cake tasting tomorrow at 11 and the dress fitting the same afternoon. Remind me to text her that evening to see which flavour they chose.
Water the plants and call the landlord about the boiler.
Julia Mensah, our old neighbour, sent a message: she and her partner are expecting twins in the spring. Remind me to post a card next week, and maybe a little gift from the baby list.
